categories.name: wallet
categories.evidence: Modifies src/wallet/legacybdb.cpp to prevent an infinite loop when parsing legacy BDB databases.
categories.rationale: Prevents an infinite loop and 100% CPU hang during legacy wallet migration and dumping on malformed databases. According to the description, cyclical empty overflow pages cause `bitcoin-wallet dump` and `migratewallet` worker threads to spin indefinitely and prevent clean `bitcoind` shutdown.
